3. Ce qui est public et ce qui reste pri: 3. What is public and what stays private
Le pseudonyme, l’avatar, la description: Nicknames, avatars, public descriptions and comments are visible to visitors. Ratings are used to calculate averages and stay associated with the account for management and duplicate prevention. Email addresses, passwords, sessions and acceptance evidence are not published.
Les projets locaux ne sont pas automatiq: Local projects are not automatically sent to the server with the account. Exports or sharing initiated by users create a copy whose destination they control. In rooms, voluntarily shared data becomes accessible to authorized participants.
L’accès interne aux données privées est: Internal access to private data is limited to the publisher and authorized people responsible for operating, securing and moderating the service. No data is transferred to partners for their own marketing.
Des prestataires techniques peuvent néan: Technical providers may process only the data needed for their task: o2switch for hosting and email; Google or Discord when you choose their sign-in; Cloudflare Turnstile for anti-bot verification on contact forms, new registrations and sign-ins after three failures. Site fonts are currently loaded from Google Fonts, which sends a technical request to Google even without an account.
Google/Discord transmettent un identifia: Google/Discord provide a sign-in ID and profile information limited to the requested authentication. The site does not request access to messages, contacts or Discord servers and does not store provider access tokens after authentication. These providers also apply their own policies to their services.
Les contributions publiques sont, par na: Public contributions are, by nature, communicated to visitors. Disclosure may also be required by law or a legally justified request from a competent authority. These situations differ from sale or commercial transfer.

Garanties et modalités vérifiées par l’é: Safeguards and procedures verified by the publisher:
Compte, profil et preuve d’acceptation :: Account, profile and acceptance evidence: for the lifetime of the account, until deletion, subject to separate retention actually required by law or an identified dispute.
Commentaires, notes et votes : jusqu’à l: Comments, ratings and votes: until withdrawal, account deletion or deletion of the related content. Editorial publications may remain without association with the deleted account.
Sessions de connexion : 30 jours maximum: Sign-in sessions: up to 30 days; temporary OAuth states: 10 minutes; password reset links: 30 minutes. Expired entries are purged when relevant routes are next processed.
Protection anti-robot des comptes : comp: Account anti-bot protection: a failure counter linked to a network-address hash is kept for up to 30 minutes after the last failure, then expires; reset after successful password sign-in. Temporary verification evidence for Google/Discord registration: five minutes before use, then linked to the OAuth state during its ten-minute validity. Expired entries are purged during requests.
Contact : le temps de traiter la demande: Contact: for as long as needed to handle the request and its follow-up; correspondence cannot be kept longer without a documented need or legal obligation.
Salles : état de jeu conservé sur l’appa: Rooms: game state is kept on the Director’s device and in .clapSalle exports. The server keeps only access and connection information in memory; an inactive room disappears from the list after 45 seconds and access expires after 90 seconds without the Director’s presence. Signals expire after 90 seconds; purges occur during requests.
Données locales de l’application : jusqu: Local application data: until deleted by the user or browser. The publisher cannot remotely delete exports saved on a device.
Le cookie de session est destiné à l’aut: The session cookie is used for authentication. A temporary cookie links Google/Discord sign-in to the requesting browser; another keeps anti-bot verification evidence for a new external registration for up to five minutes. Local storage and IndexedDB keep preferences, working files and previews; the application cache enables offline use.
Ces mécanismes fonctionnels ne servent p: These functional mechanisms are not used for advertising. The application implements no targeted advertising or commercial profiling. The external services identified above may perform their own technical processing as described in their policies. Any later addition of a non-essential tracker requires notice and, where legally required, separate prior consent.
Les mots de passe sont stockés sous form: Passwords are stored as salted, secure hashes. Access and permissions are checked on the server. These measures reduce risks without guaranteeing absolute security.
Dans les conditions du RGPD, vous pouvez: Under GDPR conditions, you may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction and portability of the relevant data, and object to processing based on legitimate interests. Where processing actually relies on optional consent, that consent may be withdrawn without retroactive effect. The registration checkbox is not general consent to all processing.
en précisant votre compte et le droit ex: and specify your account and the right exercised. Proof of identity will be requested only where there is reasonable doubt and in a proportionate manner.
